baseline_fields.evidence_summary: PCEF now includes a bounded guarded persistent-session and privacy-first trace envelope validated across separate Python processes. Successful tool runs require INPUT, TOOL_INPUT, TOOL_OUTPUT and OUTPUT guardrail stages, a valid hash-chained trace, independent PCEF verification and the canonical eight-receipt terminal lifecycle. Missing OUTPUT or TOOL_OUTPUT stages fail safe in explicit omission tests; a TOOL_INPUT canary tripwire leaves zero effects. Session context survives process reopen with secret-shaped values redacted, hidden reasoning rejected, raw trace payloads represented by digests, and the canary secret absent from persistent SQLite bytes. A separate combined-master exact-head run proved compatibility with concurrently merged One-Fabric estate-registry/constitution work. Production model execution, distributed session service, native runtime binding, external-provider effects and universal production adoption remain unproven.
baseline_fields.single_extra_feature: Sovereign Proof-Carrying Autonomy: persistent agent context, guardrails and traces are bound into the same authority/effect/verification completion law rather than treated as optional telemetry.
baseline_fields.8x8_parity_gate: Bind guarded persistent sessions and privacy-first trace completeness into real production agent/provider lanes, preserve strict required-stage guardrails across handoffs and tool effects, and prove the same semantics on native and external-provider execution without weakening PCEF.

frontier_patch.definition: Every consequential agent/tool/external effect must carry authorization-bound, idempotent, replay-verifiable proof before terminal completion; risky execution must prove its isolation boundary; guarded runs must additionally prove persistent-session continuity, required guardrail-stage completeness and a valid privacy-first trace chain before PCEF verification.
frontier_patch.why_it_is_one_feature: It remains one proof-carrying completion law. Session continuity, guardrail verdicts, trace integrity, authority, effect commitment and independent verification are evidence-bearing phases of the same consequential action.
